# Windows PDF tool source

The Windows runtime package uses Poppler 26.09.0 from the pinned Poppler Windows release v26.09.0-0. This directory retains the matching unmodified upstream Poppler source for binary recipients. Windows build recipes are maintained at https://github.com/oschwartz10612/poppler-windows/tree/v26.09.0-0 and https://github.com/conda-forge/poppler-feedstock.

Source: https://poppler.freedesktop.org/poppler-26.09.0.tar.xz

SHA-256: `8059eadb6805340768f138c465b57f8164c92b4a0773c37ef031ea6c0d987b2e`

Poppler is GPL-2.0-or-later; its source archive includes upstream notices.

`package.sh` and `release.yaml` retain the Windows packaging recipes from that exact upstream tag.
